summary.en: Choose lists, sets and maps by their ordering, lookup and duplicate rules.
summary.bn: অর্ডার, ডুপ্লিকেট আর খোঁজার দরকার বুঝে লিস্ট, সেট বা ম্যাপ বেছে নাও।

notes: Collection APIs used here are available in Java 17; List.of (Java 9) creates an unmodifiable list.

sections.title: Choose the shape of your data
Compare operation costs and ordering rules
Plan for empty data and changing keys
State the reason for your collection

examples.title: List order and indexed removal
examples.explanationHtml: remove(1) selects an index; remove(Integer.valueOf(60)) selects the first equal value. Lists retain duplicate elements.

examples.title: Set uniqueness with ordered reporting
examples.explanationHtml: HashSet rejects an equal duplicate. TreeSet sorts the report instead of relying on hash iteration order.

examples.title: Count course registrations
examples.explanationHtml: merge starts absent counts and adds to existing counts. A TreeMap view makes the final key order explicit.

examples.title: Use a linked deque at both ends
examples.explanationHtml: LinkedList implements both List and Deque. This example uses end operations rather than repeated indexed lookup.

practice.title: Distinct roll numbers
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..30), then n roll numbers (1..1000). Print distinct rolls in ascending order, one per line. Print nothing for n=0. Use a Set.
hints: TreeSet combines uniqueness with ascending iteration.

practice.title: Course frequency table
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..30), followed by n uppercase ASCII course codes of 1..8 letters. Print each distinct code and its count separated by one space, ordered lexicographically by code.
hints: A map stores one count per key; updating a key does not append another entry.

practice.title: Select a representation
practice.statementHtml: Choose a collection for indexed exam marks, unique room names, and roll-to-CGPA lookup. Explain each choice.
practice.answerHtml: ArrayList offers constant-time indexed mark access. HashSet provides expected constant-time uniqueness tests for room names. HashMap maps each roll to one CGPA. Use tree variants if sorted iteration is required.
hints: Separate sequence, membership and key-to-value needs.

practice.title: Remove while iterating
practice.statementHtml: A for-each loop removes failed marks from an ArrayList through list.remove. Give a safe replacement.
practice.answerHtml: Use removeIf(mark -> mark < 40), or use an Iterator and its remove method after next. Structural mutation through the list during ordinary iteration can cause ConcurrentModificationException. Fail-fast detection is best effort, not a concurrency control mechanism.

quiz.prompt: How do the index and Integer removal overloads change this list?
quiz.explanation: The int argument removes index one; the boxed value then removes the first 60.

quiz.prompt: What does adding Lab twice do before the sorted set report?
quiz.explanation: An existing equal element is not inserted again; TreeSet iterates in natural order.

quiz.prompt: Which course counts are printed in key order?
quiz.explanation: The third token updates CSE; sorting keys fixes the display order.

quiz.prompt: Which collection usually suits frequent indexed reads?
quiz.explanation: ArrayList indexes its backing array; LinkedList must traverse links.

quiz.prompt: What is guaranteed about HashMap iteration order?
quiz.explanation: Choose an ordered map or sort entries when presentation order matters.

quiz.prompt: How does TreeSet decide that two elements are duplicates?
options: They have equal hash codes only
quiz.explanation: TreeSet uses its ordering relation; keep that relation consistent with equals when possible.

quiz.prompt: Which Map operation exposes both keys and values during traversal?
quiz.explanation: Each Map.Entry supplies getKey and getValue.

quiz.prompt: Which removal call deletes the Integer value 2 from a List<Integer>?
quiz.explanation: A primitive int selects indexed removal; the wrapper selects object removal.
List.of returns an unmodifiable list and rejects null elements.

quiz.prompt: What is HashSet lookup’s usual expected cost with well-distributed hashes?
quiz.explanation: Hash tables offer expected constant-time basic operations, not universal worst-case constant time.

quiz.prompt: Which map operation checks absence without confusing a stored null?
quiz.explanation: In maps that allow null values, get alone cannot distinguish absence from a stored null.

keyPoints.en: Lists keep positions and allow equal elements.
keyPoints.bn: লিস্টে প্রতিটি মানের পজিশন থাকে, একই মান একাধিকবারও রাখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Sets enforce uniqueness through equality or ordering.
keyPoints.bn: সেট সমতা বা তুলনার নিয়ম দিয়ে ডুপ্লিকেট বাদ দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Maps associate one value with each key.
keyPoints.bn: ম্যাপে প্রতিটি কি বা key-এর সঙ্গে একটি মান থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Hash collections do not promise display order.
keyPoints.bn: হ্যাশ কালেকশনে কোন মান আগে আসবে, তার নিশ্চয়তা নেই।

keyPoints.en: Select a collection by the operations you need most.
keyPoints.bn: কোন কাজটা বেশি করবে, সেটা ভেবেই কালেকশন বেছে নাও।

examQuestions.question: Compare ArrayList and LinkedList for marks processing.
examQuestions.answerHtml: ArrayList gives O(1) indexed access and amortized O(1) append, with O(n) middle shifting. LinkedList gives O(n) indexed lookup and O(1) end operations. Insertion through an already positioned iterator avoids searching, but finding that position still costs time.

examQuestions.question: Design a registration count report that is deterministic.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Use HashMap<String,Integer> with merge(code,1,Integer::sum) for counting. Copy into TreeMap before iterating entrySet, or use TreeMap throughout. Handle zero registrations by printing no entries. Equal keys update one stored value.

examQuestions.question: Explain why a mutable key can disappear from a HashMap lookup.
examQuestions.answerHtml: If fields used by equals or hashCode change after insertion, the key may hash to a different bucket. The existing entry remains stored under its original placement. Prefer immutable keys or remove the entry before changing those fields.
